candidates.detail: GeneratedArmor exposes positions, flat indices and per-triangle PlateFace values as public mutable fields. Public PlateLining::new collects each Inner triangle and directly indexes the combined positions while calculating its rim keys, without checking the triangle indices against the contributing piece. For one piece with three positions, indices [0,1,3] and faces [Inner], the selected triangle is nonempty; the second edge needs positions[3] and therefore indexes past a three-element array. The Option return distinguishes absence of selected inner triangles but cannot report this malformed geometry. This is source and array-bound reasoning only: no armor, lining or panic was executed.
candidates.consumer_and_safeguards: The inspected studio path obtains fitted GeneratedArmor via parametric_equipment::fit, keeps fits in StudioCache and constructs a lining from cached rigid pieces; the outfit path similarly filters fitted rigid pieces before calling PlateLining::new. Garment drape later uses the retained lining to tuck cloth under plate. No malformed generated fit or supported production route to the constructed invalid input has been shown, and the fitting/device/index contracts remain open. Legitimate pieces with no Inner triangles return None.
candidates.connected_scope: GeneratedArmor construction and mutation, per-piece triangle/index and face correspondence, PlateLining rim/BVH construction, studio fit cache, optional UnderPlate and drape consumers. The separate unvalidated zip truncation or cross-piece reference behavior is not established as a production defect by this witness.
candidates.proposed_repair: After exhaustive discovery and separate implementation authorization, establish a checked generated-armor topology owner or a fallible lining admission boundary before indexing and propagate a contextual error through affected callers. Preserve the legitimate no-plate None case and valid cached rigid-piece behavior; account for component-local bounds and face correspondence.
candidates.later_acceptance: When product validation is authorized, show invalid per-piece indices and mismatched face records are rejected without panics or cross-piece aliasing, valid generated plates produce equivalent lining, and no-inner-face inputs retain the intended absent-lining behavior.
